title: Dense-open localization reduction
statement:
Let $X$ be a reduced curve and $F$ a constructible $\mathbf F_\ell$-sheaf.
There is a dense open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ with
$U=\coprod_iU_i$ irreducible and $F|_U$ finite locally constant. If
$i:Z=X\setminus U\hookrightarrow X$, then

$$
0\longrightarrow j_!j^{-1}F\longrightarrow F
\longrightarrow i_*i^{-1}F\longrightarrow0
$$

reduces extension-invariance to $j_!G$ and to sheaves on the zero-dimensional
scheme $Z$.

proof.text: Apply the existing generic-constancy theorem to obtain a dense open V on which F is finite locally constant. Shrink V by the proved dense irreducible-opens theorem. This yields finitely many disjoint irreducible opens U_a, their dense union W, zero-dimensional complement, and irreducible connected components in W. Finite local constancy of each restriction and of the restriction to W follows from upperStar_of_range_subset because U_a and W lie inside V.
Apply the dense-open prime-coefficient assertion equivalence to W to identify assertions for F with those for extension by zero of its restriction to W.
Choose W as the existential witness, using irreducibility of its connected components and finite local constancy established above.
